title: Apsander
summary: Raleigh names Apsander in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Apsander, one of those three Gouernours. Of him Raleigh findes onely the name. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVII, §. VI, sig. 368b
